facts.fact: The Lusaka Magistrates' Court convicted vlogger Joseph Chishimba, 47, under section 54 of the Cyber Security and Cyber Crimes Act No. 2 of 2021 for sending a WhatsApp group a screenshot, posted 9 to 14 October 2024, alleging that presidential aide Chipokota Mwanawasa was in a relationship with President Hichilema and pregnant; he denied publishing it.
